paragraphs.text:
The Dean shakes his head, “Out of the question, Grunewald. I 
already have that young dolt Perkins covering for Gliere. And 
now you want to leave? Not a chance, sir.” Does the Dean leave 
you no choice? To threaten to resign, go to 186. To forget the 
whole business and let Gliere fend for himself, go to 574.
(82)
